title: Payload of `challenge`
description: gateway → node: the first message on every connection, signed `gw-transport` (§6.1 step 2, R6-1). A fresh single-use nonce, the gateway's clock (`expires_at` = `issued_at` + 30 s) and the gateway's current key. Pre-authentication: it authorises nothing.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters); the challenge's nonce.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
